data.name: Vitus
data.gender_notes: Vitus is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Latin, Vitus means 'life, vitality'. This name was given to a 3rd-century saint and martyr who is the patron saint of epileptics, wrestlers, and actors. The name Vitus carries the meaning “Life, vitality” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Latin. Parents who choose Vitus usually hope their child will grow to embody life, vitality and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the strength and vitality of the Christian spirit
data.etymology: Vitus belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Life, vitality.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vitus total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: In the Middle Ages, Saint Vitus was considered the protector of actors and wrestlers. In some European countries, actors would perform a charity show on his feast day to seek his blessing for a successful season. The association with wrestlers may arise from Vitus' legend as a patron against epilepsy, a condition believed to make one weak or 'uncoordinated'.
data.spiritual_significance: Saint Vitus is believed to intercede for us in matters related to vitality, strength, and endurance. His name speaks of life in all its fullness and is a reminder of God's gift of life. Spiritually, we can call upon Saint Vitus for support and encouragement in our daily struggles, as he embodies the resilience and tenacity needed to live a life rooted in faith.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Vitus is the name of an early Christian martyr, who is the patron saint of fishermen, actors, and comedians. His name symbolizes strength in adversity and faith in the face of persecution. In the chaos of life, Vitus reminds us to remain steadfast in our beliefs and to find joy even in difficult situations.
